source_note.use: causal mechanism proposal only; not evidence of profitability

claim: An extreme spot-led BTC return divergence predicts same-direction perpetual continuation over the next eight hours because derivatives have not yet fully incorporated spot demand or supply.

mechanism.long: positive spot return and extreme positive spot-minus-perpetual return z-score
mechanism.short: negative spot return and extreme negative spot-minus-perpetual return z-score
mechanism.volume_filter: optional confirmation requires spot relative-volume z-score to exceed perpetual relative-volume z-score
mechanism.abstention: no signal when spot return direction and divergence direction disagree

required: actual funding settlements for position cashflow

signal_timing.features: completed hourly bars only; rolling z-scores use prior observations and exclude the signal bar
signal_timing.signal_bar: completed hour with directional spot return and extreme spot-minus-perpetual return divergence
